title: Fintech vs Traditional Banking: What’s the Real Difference?
description:
Fintech and traditional banks both manage money, but they work very differently. Fintech companies use digital technology, mobile apps, and automation to deliver faster payments, lower fees, and better user experiences. Traditional banks rely on physical branches, established systems, and strict regulations that focus on stability and trust. This simple comparison explains how fintech is transforming modern finance and why both systems still play an important role today.

title: Gravitas Typeface | Type of Feeling
description: Gravitas is a condensed serif typeface inspired by the Latin word meaning weight, dignity, and substance. It evokes that sense of authority that doesn’t need to shout. Quiet power. In design, this shows up through clean structure and restraint. The condensed proportions create momentum, and the minimal difference in stroke weight creates solidity within each letterform, word, and paragraph. This typeface is designed for quick information intake without sacrificing beauty. Created for those who speak with self-assurance rather than volume, Gravita will work best for brands seeking to enhance their authority, steadiness, and control.

title: Durga Puja Prep Week 2 — Night Skincare Routine for Festive Glow
description: 24 days to Durga Puja!Give your skin some nighttime care with a simple, consistent routine focused on hydration and barrier support. Start with a gentle cleanser, then apply niacinamide if it suits your skin, followed by a moisturizer to help reduce dryness and support a healthy-looking skin barrier. If you already use retinol and have built tolerance, you can include it at night as directed—but don’t start a strong retinoid right before the festive season or combine too many irritating actives at once. Retinol can help improve the appearance of uneven texture, fine lines, and pigmentation over time, but it won’t reliably produce clearer, glowing skin by the next morning. #DurgaPujaPrep #NightRoutine #SeptemberSkincare #Retinol #Niacinamide #FestiveGlow #DurgaPuja

title: Durga Puja Skin Glow — Week 1 Routine Starts Today
description: 29 days to Durga Puja! Start Week 1 of your festive skin-prep routine with a focus on gentle cleansing, brightening, and hydration. Begin with a mild cleanser to remove sweat, oil, and buildup, then use a gentle exfoliating toner only as directed—especially if you’re new to exfoliating acids. Follow with a vitamin C serum to support a brighter, more even-looking complexion, then finish with moisturizer. ☀️ Always use broad-spectrum SPF during the day, as sun exposure can make pigmentation more noticeable. Avoid using exfoliating toner and other strong actives too frequently, since irritation can lead to redness and sensitivity.#DurgaPujaPrep #FestiveGlow #SeptemberSkincare #VitaminC #GlowingSkin #SkincareRoutine

title: Pre-Diwali Skin Care: What Should You Do 15 & 7 Days Before Diwali?
description:
Can you really get your skin festive-ready in just one day?

A facial the night before Diwali, a brightening face pack in the morning, and a little extra moisturiser before makeup. Sounds like a familiar festive skincare plan?

But here's the catch. Dullness, uneven texture, pigmentation, and dehydration don't necessarily improve with one last-minute skincare session.

Your skin needs consistent care, and the days leading up to Diwali are a good opportunity to focus on hydration, skin barrier health, and a routine that suits your skin type.

So, what should you start doing 15 days before Diwali, and what deserves your attention during the final 7 days?

The answer isn't about adding more products. It's about knowing what your skin needs—and when.
